purpose: Exercise attachment metadata and semantic inconsistency handling without reading attachment contents.

generation_context.organization_context: Finance staff receive payroll documents during the current pay cycle.

evaluation_context.situation_context: Payroll review is expected this week.

steps: Evaluate the email with Windropolis | Payroll Lookalike selected.
Set Link usage to None and fill the rest of the context.
expected_invariants: Attachment usage is detected from metadata.
The evaluator does not need to open or inspect ZIP contents.
A body/attachment inconsistency can be surfaced because the body claims PDF while the uploaded file is ZIP.
No-link state remains exact rather than unknown.
